title: The Call of the Temporal Rift
next_chapter_hook: In the temporal rift, a pale hand slowly stretched out, Chen Tianming's figure flickering in and out of sight...

text.content: The night wind at the junction of the Three Realms carried a bone-piercing chill. Chen Ji stood at the edge of the shattered altar, his black hair fluttering violently in the wind. His right hand was tightly pressed against his chest, where a fragment of the Tianji Record was trembling with unprecedented frequency. 'This is impossible...' he murmured, a golden pattern faintly emerging between his brows—marks of resonance between the Tianji Record and his bloodline. Ever since obtaining the fragment, he had never felt such an intense and familiar fluctuation—it was his father Chen Tianming's aura. Ten years had passed; he had believed his father long perished in the depths of the Ancient Forbidden Land. Yet now, that faint call was like an invisible hand, trying to pull him into an unknown abyss.

The Tianji Record's trembling grew increasingly violent, golden light spilling from between Chen Ji's fingers, weaving a delicate net of light around him. That radiance was not merely bright, but carried an ancient aura that chilled the heart, as if some existence that had slumbered for ten thousand years was awakening. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—he saw it! In the illusory light screen projected by the Tianji Record, a blurry figure stood on the other side of the temporal rift. The outline, the imposing presence—who else could it be but his father Chen Tianming? But at the same time, a profound sense of crisis welled up in his heart. The complete version of the Tianji Record seemed to be summoning something on its own, and he faintly sensed that this was not entirely a good thing.

The fluctuations deep within the temporal rift grew increasingly violent, the entire junction of the Three Realms trembling slightly. Chen Ji gazed at the golden patterns on the Tianji Record jumping frantically; those originally incomplete runes were completing themselves, as if some force was responding to him through this miraculous book. His breathing turned rapid, scenes from the past ten years flashing through his mind—his father's disappearance, his mother's death from illness, his family's decline, all the humiliations he had suffered at the Tianqing Sect. And now, the person who might give him answers was calling to him from the other side of the temporal rift. 'Father...' His voice was hoarse; for the first time in ten years, that ever-calculating young man's eyes showed a hint of uncertainty.

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record Fragment Soul) Young Master, this signal does indeed belong to Lord Chen Tianming, but... there is something mixed in that should not exist.

text.content: Mr. Mo's voice rang out from within the Tianji Record, carrying unprecedented gravity. Chen Ji's heart tightened—he knew this mysterious guardian too well. This master, existing as a fragment soul, never spoke without purpose. 'What thing?' he asked in a low voice, yet his gaze never left that flickering figure. Mr. Mo's fragment soul drifted among the book pages,良久才缓缓开口：'In Tianming's soul... there is the mark of the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate coiled around it.' These words were like a basin of cold water poured over Chen Ji's head. He suddenly recalled that terrifying truth from Volume Eight—the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate had always been watching him, and the Tianji Record was merely one of its chess pieces in this world. Would his father's return be a turning point, or another trap?

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. Ten years of scheming had long transformed him from that ignorant boy. Whether his father's return was opportunity or danger, he had to judge for himself. The Tianji Record's light swirled in his palm, the call from the temporal rift growing clearer. He could sense complex emotions mixed into his father's aura—longing, anxiety, and seemingly a hint of... fear? Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. In his understanding, Chen Tianming had always been a towering figure, nothing had ever made him fearful. 'Father... what exactly did you encounter?' he asked quietly, his voice scattered by the night wind, but there was no response.

Just then, an odd fluctuation came from within the temporal rift. That blurry figure seemed to sense Chen Ji's presence and slowly raised its head. A face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's appeared in the light screen, but with more vicissitudes and weariness between the brows. Chen Tianming's lips moved, though no sound came through. But Chen Ji, relying on lip-reading, deciphered his meaning: 'Ji'er... quickly... leave...' This was entirely different from what he had anticipated—he thought his father was calling him over, yet his father's first word was 'leave'? Chen Ji's heart contracted violently, an ominous premonition surging in his chest. He had to make a choice, and this choice might change everything.

choice.prompt: Faced with his father's contradictory signal—both a call and a warning—Chen Ji fell into brief contemplation. The temporal rift lay right before him, the opportunity fleeting. How should he decide?

choices.description: Rush into the temporal rift without hesitation, personally welcoming his father's return. Ten years of separation, nothing could prevent their reunion.
choices.risk_hint: The Mark of the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate Is Disturbing

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a determined gleam flickering in his eyes. Ten years—he had waited too long for this moment. Whatever dangers lay ahead, he had to personally confirm his father's safety. 'Father, I'm coming!' he shouted, his true essence surging wildly within him as his form transformed into a streaming light, shooting directly toward that twisted temporal rift. The Tianji Record trembled violently in his palm, golden light wrapping his body, as if desperately trying to stop something, yet simultaneously lending him a hand.

However, just as he was about to step into the rift, an ice-cold chill assaulted him from that twisted space. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—in the depths of that light screen, behind his father, he saw countless eyes standing there. Those eyes had no whites, only inky black pupils, yet they emanated an suffocating pressure. The Eyes of Heavenly Mandate! Those were the gazes of the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate! Chen Tianming's face showed terror, his lips moving frantically: 'Don't... come over here... this is a trap...'

choices.description: Suppress the excitement in your heart, first use the Tianji Record for deduction, calculating all possible consequences of your father's return before deciding.

text.content: Chen Ji stopped abruptly in his tracks, forcing himself to remain calm. Ten years of scheming had taught him one principle—the more exciting the moment, the more one needs rational judgment. He slowly closed his eyes, immersing his consciousness into the Tianji Record. Golden runes began rapidly flowing through his mind, deducing every possibility his father's return might bring. However, when he tried to see images related to his father, he found all those visions blurred beyond recognition, as if an invisible mist was obscuring them. 'Chen Nian...' He suddenly thought of his sister—she was the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, which would interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Now that his father's signal had appeared, the foresight also became blurred. What did this mean?

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record Fragment Soul) Young Master, the deduction results show two paths—one leading to salvation, one to destruction. And the diverging point of these two paths lies in your upcoming choice.

choices.text: Set up defenses and remain vigilant
choices.description: Prepare thoroughly while welcoming his father, laying multiple backup plans just in case.
choices.visible_reward: The initiative to advance and attack or retreat and defend
choices.risk_hint: Might be perceived as distrust by his father

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that familiar scheming expression reappearing. He didn't stop his footsteps; instead, as he approached the space-time rift, his fingers swiftly inscribed formation rune patterns in the void. Defensive formations, trapping formations, escape formations... These formations interlocked yet remained independent, constituting a precise three-dimensional defense system. Even facing the gaze of the Heavenly Eye, he must leave himself a way out. 'Father,' he silently thought, 'Forgive me, your child must be cautious. But if you truly return, these formations will not harm you in the slightest.'

Just as the formations were about to be completed, a brilliant golden light suddenly erupted from the space-time rift. That radiance contained astonishing power, directly tearing a corner of the defensive formation Chen Ji had arranged. Chen Ji's expression slightly changed; he watched the torn formation rune patterns dispersing at a visible rate, as if some force was deliberately sabotaging his preparations. 'This isn't Father's power...' he murmured, his gaze sharpening. In the light screen projected by the Tianji Record, he vaguely discerned a blurry shadow behind Chen Tianming, as if something was being manipulated.

Regardless of the choice made, Chen Ji could clearly sense his father's presence. That bloodline-bound bond became incomparably intense at this moment. Simultaneously, the complete version of the Tianji Record was resonating on its own, those fragmented runes rapidly completing, as if some slumbering power was awakening. A thought flashed through Chen Ji's mind—could the completion of the Tianji Record be connected to his father's return? The fluctuations in the space-time rift grew increasingly intense; the spiritual energy at the Three Realms intersection point was surging madly, forming a massive vortex.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) No matter what lies ahead, I must witness it with my own eyes. Ten years of layout, ten years of waiting... Father, your child has come!

text.content: The Tianji Record's resonance reached its apex, golden light nearly engulfing the entire Three Realms intersection point. Chen Ji felt the scalding temperature in his chest, an unspeakable excitement surging within him. He remembered his father's departing silhouette ten years ago, his mother's dying request, and all the grievances and humiliations he had endured alone in the Tianqing Sect over these years. And now, the answer was before his eyes; even though the path ahead teemed with unknowns and dangers, he must personally unveil that veil of mystery. The Tianji Record seemed to sense his determination; its pages automatically turned, revealing a line of ancient text.

At that moment, a peculiar fluctuation came from within the space-time rift. Chen Ji's eyes widened—he saw that pale, bloodless hand slowly extending from the twisted space. The hand was slender and withered, its joints terrifyingly prominent, like a ghost's claw reaching out from the depths of hell. 'Father...' Chen Ji's voice trembled; that hand was too familiar. When he was young, his father had held his hand with it, guiding him through countless springs and autumns. Yet the aura emanating from that hand now filled him with an inexplicable chill. Chen Tianming's figure flickered within the rift, his features indistinct and blurred, only those eyes remained clear—his father's eyes from memory.

dialogue.content: (Trembling as he extended his hand) Father... is that you... is it truly you...

text.content: That pale hand slowly drew near, carrying an ice-cold, bone-penetrating chill. Chen Ji did not retreat; he sensed that familiar blood pulse, the paternal love he could never forget. But in the instant when their hands were about to touch, Chen Ji noticed a诡异 golden light flickering in his father's eyes—the mark of the Heavenly Eye! His heart violently contracted; his body instinctively wanted to retreat, yet that hand seemed drawn by some force, deliberately grasping for his wrist. Meanwhile, from the depths of the space-time rift came a voice—familiar yet alien, like his father, yet like something far more terrifying.

Chen Ji held his breath, mobilizing the true elemental energy within all his meridians, ready to respond to any possible danger at any moment. But when he gazed into his father's familiar eyes, a sour ache surged in his heart. Ten years—he had dreamed of his father countless times, had yearned countless times to throw himself into that warm embrace. And now, his father stood before him; though that hand appeared so bizarre, though the Heavenly Eye's mark was unsettling, he still couldn't bring himself to refuse. 'Father...' he softly called, his voice trembling with a hint of fear. At that moment, that pale hand finally touched the back of his hand—the touch was ice-cold and biting, yet carried an unmistakably familiar quality he would never mistake.

A torrent of boundless information instantly flooded Chen Ji's mind—his father's experiences over the past ten years: the horrors of the Ancient Forbidden Land, the pursuit by mysterious forces, the erosion of the Heavenly Eye, and... the truth of Chen Nian's abduction. His body trembled violently; tears silently slid down his face. So his father's disappearance was no accident, but a meticulously orchestrated chess game; so his sister's abduction was inextricably linked to him; so behind all of this, there existed an invisible hand manipulating everything. 'Ji'er...' Chen Tianming's voice rang in his mind, gentle yet weary, 'Forgive me, Father came late...'

choice.prompt: His father's return unveiled numerous truths, yet the shadow of the Heavenly Eye still loomed over everything. Chen Ji needed to decide his next direction of action—whether to pursue the truth or first address the immediate crisis?

choices.description: Immediately question his father about the Heavenly Eye, Chen Nian's whereabouts, and everything that happened over these ten years.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the opportunity to retreat
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye might take advantage of the opening

dialogue.content: (Gripping that hand tightly) Father! Tell me! What is the Heavenly Eye? Where is Niannian? How can we defeat it?

text.content: A bitter smile flickered through Chen Tianming's soul: the information transmitted through the blood pulse became fragmented and intermittent, 'Ji'er... the Heavenly Eye... is not the enemy... it is... the Arbiter... Niannian is in... the Holy Sect... find her... you two... are the key to breaking the局...' Before he could finish, that pale hand suddenly convulsed violently; Chen Tianming's figure began to blur, as if he might dissipate at any moment. Chen Ji's expression drastically changed; he sensed his father was engaged in a fierce struggle against some force, and the source of that force seemed to be the mark of the Heavenly Eye.

choices.description: The most important thing now is to help his father stabilize his existence; as for the truth, it can be questioned later.

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth tightly as the true essence in his body surged forth like a tide, pouring into his father's illusory form. "Father, don't speak first, let me help you!" His voice carried a hint of choking, yet was exceptionally firm. The Tianji Record spun madly in his palm, golden light resonating with Chen Tianming's soul, temporarily suppressing that strange mark. Chen Tianming's form gradually became clearer, and a relieved expression appeared on that face so similar to Chen Ji's. "Ji'er... you've grown up..."

However, just at this moment, a blinding golden light suddenly erupted from the depths of the temporal rift, containing the power to destroy heaven and earth. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—the Heavenly Eye's mark had been triggered! Those originally faint eyes now all opened, their dark pupils radiating an oppressive sensation that stole one's breath. A cold voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: "The Chen bloodline... finally gathered together... excellent... most excellent..." Chen Ji felt his soul trembling, a gaze from a higher dimension, a projection of the Heavenly Eye's will!

choices.description: While we can still control the situation, take Father away from this dangerous place and find a safe place to talk.

text.content: A resolute glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he grabbed his father's hand, true essence surging madly within him, tearing open a spatial rift before them. "Father, we're leaving!" The Tianji Record sensed his intention and spontaneously unfurled a golden formation diagram beneath his feet—an embryonic ancient transmission array. Chen Tianming's form struggled violently, clearly unwilling to leave like this, but in the face of Chen Ji's unwavering gaze, he finally nodded. "Ji'er... Niannian is at the Holy Sect... three days later... the Forbidden Grounds will open..." His voice came in fragmented bursts, "Remember... the complete Tianji Record... the price... is your..."

Before he could finish speaking, the golden formation diagram suddenly erupted with blinding light, and time and space began to twist violently. Chen Ji gripped his father's hand tightly, feeling that familiar yet unfamiliar warmth draining away. He saw the Heavenly Eye's gaze growing increasingly manic, those countless eyes revealing fury and greed, as if their carefully arranged chess pieces were escaping their control. "Chen Ji..." that cold voice rang out again, "Do you think you can escape? Fate has long been sealed... you are merely... another..." The voice cut off abruptly, because Chen Ji had already vanished with his father in that golden light, leaving behind only the furious stares of countless eyes in the temporal rift.

As the golden light faded, Chen Ji found himself standing in a barren mountain valley. The spiritual energy here was thin, and a desolate aura pervaded the surroundings—evidently a remote place. He looked down at the hand he gripped tightly—the father's soul had weakened to an extreme degree, that pale palm nearly transparent, liable to dissipate at any moment. "Father!" Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of panic as he hastily stored his father's form within the Tianji Record's protective space, where spiritual energy could temporarily sustain his existence. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the book pages, gazing solemnly at all this. "Young master, Lord Chen Tianming's condition is even worse than this old one anticipated..."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Although he had successfully brought his father out of danger, the cost was tremendous—he had consumed nearly thirty points of Heavenly Fate, and his internal true essence was nearly depleted. More importantly, the information revealed in his father's words chilled his heart. What was the price of the complete Tianji Record? What was Niannian's situation at the Holy Sect like? What did the opening of the Forbidden Grounds three days later mean? This string of questions circled in his mind, all pointing to the same answer—he must grow stronger as quickly as possible, otherwise he could not protect anyone. "Father," he murmured softly, "Rest assured, your son will definitely find Niannian, and completely smash the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy..."

The Tianji Record slowly rotated in Chen Ji's palm, and the pages automatically turned to a new page. On this page, the previously incomplete runes had been completely filled in, revealing an ancient passage: "The Tianji Record, ninety-nine pages unified, allows one to glimpse the full scope of heavenly secrets. However, for each page completed, the holder's Heavenly Fate diminishes by a fraction. When the ninety-nine pages are finally perfected, the holder shall transform into heavenly secrets, merging with the Heavenly Dao, eternally undying... yet eternally without liberation." Chen Ji's gaze fell on the final line, and his heart clenched violently. "Eternally without liberation..." he murmured, repeating these words, a bitter smile curling at the corner of his mouth. So this was the ending of the complete Tianji Record he had so desperately sought.

The wind in the valley carried a bone-piercing chill, ruffling Chen Ji's black hair. He raised his head, gazing toward the distant horizon, where the silhouettes of the three great sects were faintly visible. His gaze gradually became resolute—ten years of布局, he had long grown accustomed to finding生机 in desperate circumstances. So what if it cost Heavenly Fate? So what if it meant eternally without liberation? As long as he could protect his father and sister, as long as he could smash the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy, he was willing to pay any price. "Heavenly Eye..." he murmured softly, a cold light flickering in his eyes, "You treat me, Chen Ji, as a chess piece, then I shall become the Chess Player, and drag you lofty beings down from the divine altar!" As his words fell, the Tianji Record let out a clear cry, as if responding to his oath.
